title: Contain late CodeStateWatcher backend errors after stop
problem: A filesystem watcher can report an asynchronous backend error after shutdown; that late callback must not restart reconciliation or move the stopped lifecycle back to degraded.

acceptanceCriteria.condition: After stop, a late watcher error leaves CodeStateWatcher.status equal to stopped.
A late watcher error after stop does not schedule overflow or reconciliation callbacks.
The targeted watcher and daemon lifecycle tests pass on Windows Node 24 and the existing Linux/macOS matrix remains green.
The full repository verify, release checks, and installed-package smoke test pass without changing the 13-tool compatibility surface.
